metadata.title: SpringBoard Home Gesture Recognition & Arbitration State Machine

bottom_exclusion_zone.description: Touches initiating with y >= 858.0pt are captured by the home gesture recognizer before passing to application content.

touch_slop_gate.description: Gesture recognizer remains in POSSIBLE state until upward vertical travel exceeds 8.0pt.

dwell_for_switcher_gate.description: If user holds finger stationary (dwell >= 180ms and velocity < 50pt/s), gesture transitions to App Switcher.

commit_to_home_velocity_gate.description: Upward flick velocity < -500pt/s or displacement > 305.9pt commits to Home Screen.

participant_priority_arbitration.description: Priority hierarchy governing ownership of the bottom home affordance and gesture preemption

priority_tiers.preemption_behavior: Absolute preemption; intercepts all edge swipes when device is locked or CoverSheet is presenting.
Preempts application gestures while Siri or dynamic island expanded modal is active.
Used by Picture-in-Picture, Control Center overlays, and Quick Note platters.
Used on iPadOS/Stage Manager for dock invocation gestures.
Standard foreground userland application. Can assert edge protection (requires double swipe).

fsm_states.name: Possible (Monitoring Edge)
fsm_states.description: Touch detected inside the bottom 16pt exclusion zone. Awaiting vertical travel.

fsm_states.name: Began (Slop Qualified)
fsm_states.description: Upward travel exceeded 8.0pt slop. SpringBoard captures touch exclusively; application touch cancelled.

fsm_states.name: Tracking Home Swipe
fsm_states.description: Active upward dragging. App card scales down, corner radius morphs from 0pt to 55pt.

fsm_states.name: Paused In Switcher
fsm_states.description: Finger dwell duration >= 180ms with velocity < 50pt/s. Rigid haptic tick emitted; deck cards materialize.

fsm_states.name: Tracking Switcher Deck
fsm_states.description: User dragging across the multitasking deck. Lateral finger motion tracks card stack scrolling.

fsm_states.name: Arc Swipe (Quick Switch)
fsm_states.description: Trajectory forms low horizontal arc. Directly switches between adjacent foreground applications.

fsm_states.name: Committed to Home
fsm_states.description: Release satisfies Home qualification. Velocity projection calculates flight to SBIconView.

fsm_states.name: Committed to Switcher
fsm_states.description: Release satisfies Switcher qualification. App card docks into position 0 of the 3D deck stack.

fsm_states.name: Cancelled (Return to App)
fsm_states.description: Gesture aborted or dragged downward back into starting window. Snaps back to fullscreen.
